skills.name: pi-heartbeat
skills.description: Non-blocking timers and heartbeats for pi agents. Use instead of `sleep` when waiting for builds, deployments, CI pipelines, or any async process. The agent returns to idle immediately and gets woken up when the timer fires. Triggers: timer, heartbeat, wait for build, poll, cron, wake me up, non-blocking wait, check back later, monitor deployment, periodic check.
